metadata.title: fix: resolve psycopg import error on s390x architecture (#3804)
metadata.author: akshaymohan29

description:
This change adds s390x-specific runtime fixes for the psycopg library. On s390x, psycopg is built from source and requires system libpq.so.5. Adding postgresql-libs and running ldconfig on s390x ensures that the library is available and correctively cached.

Closes #3804

commits.message:
fix: resolve psycopg import error on s390x architecture (#3804)

This change adds s390x-specific runtime fixes for the psycopg library.
On s390x, psycopg is built from source and requires system libpq.so.5.
Adding postgresql-libs and running ldconfig on s390x ensures that the
library is available and correctively cached.

Closes #3804

Signed-off-by: Akshay Mohan <AKSHAYMOHAN2790@GMAIL.COM>
